notes: Curated benchmark pairs. Coordinates from the 2026-10-18 OSM extract (POI centroids) unless noted. Each pair runs in both directions unless one_way is true. Expectations select modes by facets: traffic = quiet|balanced|busy, hills = flat|balanced|tolerant, surface = paved|mixed|dirt, plus mode = <mode name>; "*" = every mode. See bench/README.md#pair-catalogs.

pairs.name: Meyers Holiday Market to LTCC (rider notes 2026-10)
pairs.why: Rider notes: Avoid Busy Roads should stay on the Sawmill and meadow paths (6 mi, mostly Class I and dirt); Fastest should not take US 50 for 7.4 mi when Pioneer Trail (bike lane, 6.5 mi) or the 6 mi path route exists; Prefer Paved should use the Sawmill and Lake Tahoe Blvd bike paths.

expect.note: Quiet modes ride the paths; at most a short stretch of Lake Tahoe Blvd near the Y.
Prefer Paved: no dirt (the paved paths add 2 to 3 mi over the meadow route).
Fastest + Paved and Dirt: Pioneer Trail (1.09x) or the path route, not US 50 (1.24x).

pairs.name: Bridgetender, Tahoe City to Safeway, Truckee (rider notes 2026-10)
pairs.why: Rider notes: Avoid Busy Roads took a 20 mi mountain-bike loop over Northstar with 1500 ft of climbing instead of the Truckee River canyon (SR 89, 14.5 mi, 400 ft). The canyon is the only sensible route except in Prefer Dirt; Fastest should use the parallel bike paths at both ends.

expect.note: The canyon route (SR 89 and the Truckee River trail), not the Sawmill Flat / Martis Valley loop (1.39x, 448 m).
Prefer Paved stays on SR 89 instead of Old River Road (dirt).
Fastest + Prefer Dirt takes the Sawtooth Road loop (1.33x) on purpose.
Fastest still takes the Truckee River Bike Trail beside SR 89 at the Tahoe City end (use_roads 0.8).

expect.note: Known bug (engine): forward Avoid Busy Roads rides all 1.0 km on US 50 in the mixed and paved modes because Valhalla gives a bike lane a 60% stress relief whatever the road speed; reverse and Prefer Dirt already avoid it. See the 2026-10-21 rider-notes report.
